title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. asalamualykum sir, thank you for answering my previous question. 1) sir i want marriage as soon as possible because for the fear of any sin or zina. please sir provide any dua for marriage and for beautiful wife. 2) sir i want rich also before marriage so give any dua for that. thanking you 3) what is the benefits of of reciting surah muzamil after isha salah. 16435 views Q. In Ramadhan an alim from India prays 40 daruds loudly in a gathering after his bayaan. Is this permissable or not? If yes, please tell me the reasons why? As I have heard this is not allowed. 2082 views Q. Assalaamu alaikum wa rahmatullah, Dear Sheikh, I pray to Allah SWT that you are enjoying a good health & high Islamic spirit. (1) It has come to my knowledge that some people observe certain nawwafil salaah by reciting any specific surah a certain number of times( that is more than once) in each raka'ah after reading surah faati'ha. Sometimes they would make an extra sajdah after reading the tashahhud & darood and there, they would ask for any specific doah they are in need for. They would even call this salah as haajaat. However I have not cross of any of this kind of salaah in the ahadeeth. Could you please enlighten me on this. (2) My second question is about those 'aamil who after asking someone's name & mother's name, claim that they make istikhaarah salah in order to find out if that person is under the influence of jiin or evil eyes etc. As far as i understand, Istikhaarah salaah is accomplished when someone is unsure of whether doing something is good for him/her or not. But what I don't understand is how Istikhaarah salaah can help someone to find out the malady of someone else. Would that not be more appropriate to offer haajah salaah in this context? I look forward to your valuable views and comments on the above two issues Incha Allah. I thank you in anticipation for your cooperation. Wassalaam. 2469 views Q. Question: I am married my father set up bussiness for my husband many years ago.when he returned from pakistan 10 years ago his atitude towards me my parents my children has all changed for the last many years i beg him to let me meet my parents but he does not listen my health is not good .My children are disobedient and also do not listen to what i say please give me dua /wazifa that i could recite for my problems also mention how long i have to read the dua/wazifa? Answer ID: 22528 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 950/698/L=1431) Recite istighfar 100 times in the morning and evening regularly. Also, recite the following dua 100 times any time: لا أله الا أنت سبحانك أنى كنت من الظمين Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
